blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. Yet following spatial instructions in 3D scenes requires programs to construct geometric references that language leaves implicit. In this work, we introduce VoxProg, which formulates 3D object placement through voxel programming: a language model translates task interpretations into executable programs over local voxel views of scene surfaces. Because these views index surface geometry on regular grids with explicit coordinates and neighborhood relations, an evidence program can isolate task-relevant regions and boundaries directly from scene meshes, and a downstream pose program can measure the resulting geometry to compute a target $SE(3)$ pose. Visual and numerical feedback from execution lets the model inspect intermediate selections and candidate placements to iteratively revise its code. To evaluate open-ended placement across functional use, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements, we introduce the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark along with an evaluation suite pairing perceptual Intent Alignment and 3D Physical Validity. Across VoxProg-Bench and external benchmarks, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines.
blocks.zh: 语言模型解释任务和生成程序的能力为3D空间推理提供了有希望的基础. 然而在3D场景中遵循空间指令需要程序构建语言所隐含的几何引用. 在这部作品中,我们引入了VoxProg,它通过voxel编程来制定3D对象放置:一种语言模型将任务解释翻译为可执行的程序,凌驾于场景表面的局部voxel视图上. 由于这些视图在有明确坐标和相邻关系的正格上索引了地表几何,一个证据程序可以直接从场景网中分离出与任务相关的区域和边界,而下游的姿势程序可以测量由此产生的几何来计算一个目标$SE(3)$的姿势. 执行的视觉和数字反馈让模型检查中间选择和候选人职位安排,以反复修改其代码. 为了评价各种功能用途、几何相配和背景安排的开放式安放,我们采用了71任务VoxProg-Bench基准,以及一套评价套件对接感知性对接和3D物理有效性。 在整个VoxProg-Bench和外部基准中,VoxProg的业绩始终高于基于关系、关键点和网点的基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Natural-language spatial instructions often specify goals whose geometric requirements must be inferred from the scene ( Song et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . Placing a bottle inside an open display holder requires identifying the holder’s receiving structure and determining how the bottle should be positioned and oriented to fit within it. Similarly, extending a row of cups requires inferring the direction and spacing of the existing arrangement to derive the next placement target. Here, the geometric references that define the goal are themselves outcomes of spatial computation over the 3D scene.
blocks.zh: 自然语言的空间指令经常指定必须从场景中推断出几何要求的目标(Song等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年;Cheng等人,2024年). 在开放的显示器持有人内放置瓶子,需要确定持有人的接收结构,并确定瓶子应如何定位和定位,使其适合其中。 同样,延长一排杯子需要推断现有安排的方向和间隔,以得出下一个放置目标。 在这里,定义目标的几何参考物本身就是3D场景上空间计算的结果.

blocks.en: Existing approaches are limited by both the task requirements their interfaces can express and the geometric computations their representations support. Predefined task interfaces couple task coverage to task-specific implementations, limiting generalization to new spatial requirements ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2023b ; Ichter et al., 2023 ) . Geometric representations present a different difficulty: sparse keypoints can leave regions and local surface shapes under-specified ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Hua et al., 2025 ; Manuelli et al., 2022 ; Sundaresan et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) , while raw meshes require programs to organize irregular surface elements into the regions and references a task needs. Open-ended spatial reasoning therefore requires both programmatic computation that adapts to the instruction and a spatial representation that exposes scene geometry directly to code.
blocks.zh: 现有方法受到其接口可以表达的任务要求和几何计算其表示支持的限制。 预先定义的任务界面将任务涵盖范围对特定任务的执行,将通用限制在新的空间要求(Gao等人,2025年;Huang等人,2023年b;Ichter等人,2023年). 几何表示法呈现出不同的困难:小小的键点可能离开区域,局部表面形状没有规定(Huang等人,2025年b; Hua等人,2025年;Manuelli等人,2022年;Sundaresan等人,2023年;Fang等人,2024年),而原始的网状体则需要组织不规则的表面元素进入各地区,并参考一项任务需要. 因此,开放式空间推理既需要适应指令的程序计算,也需要使场景几何直接暴露于代码的空间表现.

blocks.en: To this end, we formulate voxel programming , in which a language model expresses its understanding of a spatial task as a program that constructs and operates on local voxel views (Fig. 1 ). By discretizing object surfaces onto regular grids at task-appropriate resolutions, local voxel views expose spatial coordinates and neighborhood relations directly as array operations. Generated programs can index these grids to isolate contact regions, extract boundaries, and measure local extent and orientation, turning a uniform grid representation into task-specific geometric references for pose computation.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们制定 voxel 编程,其中语言模型表达对空间任务的理解,作为构建和运行于本地 voxel 视图的程序(图1). 通过将物体表面在符合任务分辨率的常规网格上盘点,当地 voxel 视图直接将空间坐标和邻里关系暴露为数组操作. 生成的程序可以对这些网格进行索引,以隔离接触区域,提取边界,并测量局部范围与方向,将统一的网格表示转化为任务特定几何的参考,用于布局计算.

blocks.en: VoxProg realizes this formulation through a two-stage programming pipeline grounded by visual anchors and execution feedback. Starting from the instruction and raycast visual anchors, the model first writes an evidence program to construct the surface regions required by the task, such as a dish rack’s dividers and bottom support rails, and to specify the spatial relations they must satisfy. Conditioned on this constructed evidence, a pose program then queries the selected geometry to compute the moved object’s target pose. At both stages, numerical diagnostics and rendered views allow the model to verify intermediate geometry, revise faulty selections, and refine its code before execution.
blocks.zh: VoxProg通过基于视觉主播和执行反馈的两阶段编程管道实现这种配制. 从指令和射线视锚开始,模型首先写出一个证据程序来构建任务所需的表面区域,如菜架的分割器和底部支撑栏杆,并具体说明它们必须满足的空间关系. 基于这个构造的证据,一个姿势程序然后询问选定的几何来计算移动对象的目标姿势. 在这两个阶段,数字诊断和发表意见使模型能够验证中间几何,修改错误的选择,并在执行前完善其代码。

blocks.en: We evaluate VoxProg on VoxProg-Bench, a new benchmark of 71 open-ended placement tasks where target poses depend on part-level affordances, 3D shape compatibility, and surrounding layouts. Because valid placements must satisfy both semantic intent and physical plausibility, our evaluation suite pairs a perceptual ranking metric, IA Rank Score , with 3D Physical Validity checks for static support and object interpenetration. IA Rank Score measures how consistently a method’s rendered result outranks competitors in similarity to the ground-truth arrangement. Across VoxProg-Bench, VoxProg substantially outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines, achieving its largest margin on geometric tasks where object contours govern fit and clearance. Ablation studies further show that constructing explicit geometric evidence before pose synthesis improves both physical validity and intent alignment over direct mesh programming, while local voxel views further improve intent alignment across all 71 tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价VoxProg-Bench上的VoxProg,这是71个开放式布置任务的新基准,目标构成的这些任务取决于部分水平的承受力,3D形状的兼容性,以及周围的布局. 因为有效的放置必须同时满足语义意图和物理可信度,所以我们的评价套件组配对了一个感官排名度量衡,IA Rank Score,并配有静态支持和物体互通的3D物理有效性检查. IA分数衡量一种方法产生的结果如何一致地超越竞争者,与地面真实安排相似。 在整个VoxProg-Bench中,VoxProg的绩效大大超过基于关系、关键点和网点的基线,在物体轮廓决定适合和清除的几何任务上达到了最大的差幅。 校正研究进一步表明,在合成之前先构建明确的几何证据,比直接网格编程的物理有效性和意向校正性都有所改善,而局部的voxel观点则进一步改善了所有71项任务的意向校正性.

blocks.en:
Contributions. ❶ We formulate voxel programming and develop VoxProg, a two-stage system that constructs task-relevant surface geometry via local voxel views to compute 3D object placements.
❷ We introduce VoxProg-Bench, a benchmark of 71 language-guided 3D placement tasks spanning functional, geometric, and contextual arrangements.
❸ We propose a complementary evaluation protocol combining perceptual intent ranking (IA Rank Score) with 3D geometric verification (Physical Validity).

❷ 我们采用VoxProg-Bench,这是71项语言指导的3D定位任务的基准,涉及功能、几何和背景安排。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Spatial task specification. Language-guided placement has been studied through layout prediction, rearrangement search, and geometric optimization. Scene graphs encode inter-object relations for scene synthesis ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ; Lin & Mu, 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024b ) , while scene-layout and object-placement methods map language to spatial configurations ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Öcal et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Abdelreheem et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Kuang et al., 2026 ) . Rearrangement methods coordinate multi-object structures using learned spatial priors ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) or pattern-guided search ( Chang et al., 2024 ) . At a finer scale, object manipulation methods formulate 6-DoF pose optimization over sparse semantic keypoints, directional axes, and part-level affordances ( Manuelli et al., 2022 ; Hua et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 空间任务规格。 通过布局预测,重排搜索,几何优化等方法,研究了语言引导定位. 场景图表编码用于场景合成的物体间关系(陈等人,2025年;Zhai等人,2023年;Lin & Mu,2024年;Hu等人,2024年b),而场景铺设和物体布置方法则将语言映射到空间布局(冯等人,2023年;杨等人,2024年;Öcal等人,2025年;孙等人,2025年;黄等人,2025年a;Abdelreheem等人,2025年;张等人,2024年;顾昂等人,2026年). 重排方法利用已学习的空间前身协调多物体结构(刘等人,2022年;刘等人,2023年;唐等人,2024年;魏等人,2023年;许等人,2024年)或图案引导搜索(张等人,2024年). 在更细的尺度上,物体操纵方法形成6-DoF对稀疏的语义键点、方向轴和部分水平承受力的优化(Manuelli等人,2022年;Hua等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年b;Qi等人,2025年;Pan等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年).

blocks.en: While layout, surface-constraint, and keypoint formulations parameterize placement over bounding boxes, planar support patches, or sparse point and axis primitives, open-ended tasks often hinge on extended surface structures (such as receiving slots, angled ledges, curved rims, or recessed compartments) whose relevant regions depend on the instruction and paired objects. VoxProg therefore treats geometric reference construction as an explicit, programmable stage of task specification: generated code composes spatial selections and neighborhood operations over local voxel views, retaining the selected surface regions and their source-mesh patches for downstream measurement so that the same object geometry can be segmented and parameterized differently across placement tasks.
blocks.zh: 在布局、表面约束和关键点配方将放置在边框、平板支撑补丁或稀疏的点和轴原始物上参数化的同时,开放式任务往往取决于相关区域依赖于指令和配对对象的扩大的表面结构(如接收槽、角立面、弯曲边框或凹槽)。 VoxProg因此将几何参考构建作为任务规格的一个明确,可编程的阶段:生成的代码在本地的voxel视图之上组成空间选择和邻里操作,保留选定的表层区域及其源-mesh补丁进行下游测量,这样,同一对象几何可以被分解,参数化在放置任务上不同.

blocks.en: Language models for spatial computation. Executable programs let language models delegate quantitative calculation and visual queries to external interpreters ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Gupta & Kembhavi, 2023 ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024a ) . In robotics, generated code sequences task plans ( Singh et al., 2023 ) , composes perception calls with control primitives ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Mu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , and synthesizes 3D value maps over workspace grids for motion planning ( Huang et al., 2023a ) . Recent methods further incorporate geometric processing via part-mask refinement ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , primitive fitting ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , and frame-grounded tool calls ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 空间计算语言模型. 可执行程序允许语言模型将定量计算和视觉查询委托给外部口译员(Gao等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年;Gupta & Kembhavi,2023年)。 2023; Surís等人, 2023; Hu等人, 2024a). 在机器人学中,生成代码序列任务计划(Singh等人,2023年),用控制原始语(Liang等人,2023年;Mu等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年)编译感知呼叫,并合成3D值图在工作空间网格上进行运动规划(Huang等人,2023年a年). 近代方法进一步将几何处理通过部分面具精细化(Tang等人,2026年),原始装配(Lin等人,2026年),以及帧基工具调用(Chen等人,2026年).

blocks.en: In most programmatic frameworks, however, 3D perception remains encapsulated behind fixed API calls that return object centroids, bounding boxes, or pre-segmented masks ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Mu et al., 2024 ) , or operates on coarse workspace grids to score trajectories ( Huang et al., 2023a ) . We develop voxel programming so that generated code can inspect and dissect 3D object surfaces directly. By discretizing candidate objects into local voxel views at task-chosen resolutions, VoxProg turns 3D surface inspection into regular-grid array programming while retaining exact correspondence with the underlying mesh triangles. Generated code can thus construct custom surface witnesses on demand, verify them through visual and numerical feedback, and measure both grid bounds and clipped source-mesh patches to solve for precise, physically valid 6-DoF object placements.
blocks.zh: 然而,在大多数方案框架中,3D感知仍被封装在固定API调用器的后面,这些调用器还原了物体的中间体、边框或预隔口罩(Liang等人,2023年;Mu等人,2024年),或运行在粗糙的工作空间网格上以得分轨迹(Huang等人,2023年a). 我们开发了voxel编程,这样生成的代码就可以直接检查和解析3D对象表面. VoxProg通过将候选对象在任务选择的解析中磁盘化为局部的 voxel 视图,将3D表面检查转变为正格阵列编程,同时保留与基础网格三角的精确对应. 因此,生成的代码可以根据需要构建自定义的表面见证,通过视觉和数字反馈来验证它们,并测量网格边框和剪切的源-mesh补丁,以解析精确,物理上有效的6-DoF对象放置.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 illustrates this pipeline on an upright plate-placement task. The model first organizes the required spatial references into a directed evidence graph and grounds visible cues into 3D surface anchors (§ 3.1 ). blocks.en: 3.1 Task Interpretation and Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务口译和视线定位

blocks.en: An LLM formalizes its understanding of the instruction as a directed evidence graph 𝒢 = ( 𝒱 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}) . Each node v ∈ 𝒱 v\in\mathcal{V} specifies either a visible semantic anchor or a derived geometric region to be constructed, along with its functional role in the task; each directed edge ( u , v ) ∈ ℰ (u,v)\in\mathcal{E} indicates that constructing v v depends on the location or geometry of u u . In Fig. 2 , visual cues on the plate and dish rack initiate a dependency chain that extracts the plate’s outer rim together with the rack’s adjacent dividers, lower support rails, and receiving slot region.
blocks.zh: LLM 将其对指示的理解正式化为定向证据图 G = (V, E )\ mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}). 每个节点 v QQ V v\in\ mathcal{V} 指定要构造的可见语义锚或衍生几何区域, 以及它在任务中的功能作用; 每个定向边缘 (u, v) QQ E (u, v)\in\ mathcal{E} 表示构造 v 取决于 u u 的位置或几何. 在图2中,盘子和盘子架上的视觉提示启动了一个依赖链,将盘子的外缘与架子相邻的分隔器、较低的支架和接收槽区一起提取出来。

blocks.en: Each node in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is routed according to how its geometry can be acquired. For a directly visible semantic cue, Locate queries a VLM for a 2D pixel coordinate in the rendered scene image and casts a camera ray against the scene mesh to recover a 3D surface point as a spatial anchor in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . References that cannot be reduced to a single clickable pixel, such as an interior slot region, a recessed support ledge, or an occluded underside, are passed to the evidence program together with their descriptions and upstream 3D anchors, which localize where on the object mesh the program should inspect and slice the surface.

blocks.en: Benchmark. We evaluate on VoxProg-Bench, a benchmark of 71 individually curated language-guided 3D placement tasks. Each case presents an initial tabletop scene and a free-form instruction specifying the desired placement of an object. We emphasize diverse instructions that call for fine-grained reasoning about functional object parts, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements. Although an instruction can involve multiple spatial cues, each case is assigned to one group according to its primary spatial requirement for the category-level comparisons reported below: • Functional (28 cases): The placement must support a specific use, such as placing a cup beneath a grinder chute to catch grounds, returning headphones to a stand, or orienting a funnel for pouring. • Geometric (14 cases): The placement depends directly on object contours, such as nesting an oval bowl inside a matching container or fitting a baking tray into a narrow box at an angle. • Contextual (29 cases): The placement takes its cues from the surrounding arrangement, such as completing a missing place setting or restoring a symmetric layout.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价了VoxProg-Bench,这是71项由个人指导的3D定位任务的基准。 每个例都呈现一个初始的桌面场景和一个自由格式的指令,指定一个对象的理想位置. 我们强调各种指示,这些指示要求在功能物体部分、几何特征和背景安排方面进行精细的推理。 虽然一项指令可能涉及多个空间提示,但根据对下文报告的类别一级比较的主要空间要求,每个案例被分配到一组: 放置必须支持某种特定用途,例如将杯子放在磨盘槽下方以便捕捉场,将耳机还原到看台上,或者引导漏斗进行浇灌. • 几何(14个案件): 放置直接取决于物体轮廓,如在匹配容器内嵌入一个椭圆碗,或以一个角度将烘焙托盘装入一个窄盒子. • 背景(29个案件): 放置从周围的安排中取出提示,例如完成一个缺失的位置设置或恢复一个对称的布局.

blocks.en: Scenes are assembled from generated 3D assets through randomized placement and manual refinement. Detailed instructions, object geometry, and scene context make the intended final arrangement well defined; we provide one manually annotated ground-truth 6-DoF target pose per task. All methods receive the scene meshes, initial poses, instruction, and labeled target-object identity; ground-truth poses and images are used only for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 场景通过随机放置和人工改进,从生成的3D资产中组装. 详细的指令、对象几何和场景背景使预定的最后安排得到很好的界定;我们提供一份手动附加说明的地面实况6-DoF目标,每个任务。 所有方法都接收场景间隙、初始姿势、指示和标注的目标对象身份;地面真实姿势和图像仅用于评价。

blocks.en: Evaluation suite. We design an evaluation suite around two complementary requirements of object placement: realizing the intended spatial arrangement and maintaining physical plausibility. We report these as Intent Alignment and Physical Validity, using visual comparison with ground truth and geometric checks, respectively.
blocks.zh: 评估套房。 我们设计了一个评价套件,围绕物体放置的两个互补要求:实现预定的空间安排和保持物理上的合理性。 我们把这些分别用与地面真象和几何检查的直观比较来报告为意向一致和物理有效性。

blocks.en: Intent Alignment measures perceptual similarity using DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) between full-scene renderings of the predicted and ground-truth placements under matched cameras and lighting. Within each case, we rank the M M compared methods by increasing DreamSim distance and assign rank r r the score 100 ​ ( M − r ) / ( M − 1 ) 100(M-r)/(M-1) , using average ranks for ties. Averaging over cases gives the IA Rank Score (0–100; higher is better), which measures how consistently a method outranks its competitors across tasks. Each task contributes equally; scores are compared within the same method pool.
blocks.zh: 利用DreamSim(Fu等人,2023年),在相匹配的相机和照明下对预测的和地面真实的布置进行全场渲染,从而对感知的相似性进行意向调整。 在每种情况下,我们通过增加DreamSim的距离来对MM进行比对,并使用平均关系等级来分配100(M-r)/(M-1)100(M-r)/(M-1)的分数。 对案例的审视使IA排名得分(0-100;较高更好),衡量某一方法在任务上如何一贯地超越竞争对手。 每项任务的贡献是平等的;在同一个方法库中比较分数。

blocks.en: Physical Validity assesses whether the final placement establishes plausible static support and avoids interpenetration with surrounding objects. We report the percentage of evaluated task placements that satisfy both 3D contact and clearance checks.
blocks.zh: 物理有效性评估最终位置是否建立可信的静态支持,并避免与周围物体的相互渗透。 我们报告经过评估的任务安置百分比,这些任务既能满足三维联系要求,又能满足审核要求。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare VoxProg against three language-guided placement approaches. GenManip ( Gao et al., 2025 ) constructs placements using predefined spatial relations between target and anchor objects. GenSim2-kPAM ( Hua et al., 2025 ; Manuelli et al., 2022 ) specifies placement targets through predicted semantic keypoints together with geometric point and axis constraints. Direct Mesh generates Blender Python code for placement and executes it through Blender-MCP 1 1 1 https://github.com/ahujasid/blender-mcp .

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on the task suite
blocks.zh: 4.2 任务组合的结果

blocks.en: Quantitative results. VoxProg achieves the highest IA Rank Score overall ( 83.10 ) and across all three task groups, alongside the highest Physical Validity at 95.8% (Table 1 ), outperforming Direct Mesh (48.59 / 87.3%), GenSim2-kPAM (42.72 / 77.5%), and GenManip (25.59 / 73.2%). Although Direct Mesh also writes task-specific Python code over explicit scene meshes, VoxProg improves its IA Rank Score by 34.51 points and Physical Validity by 8.5 points: code generation alone remains brittle without an intermediate representation that isolates the surfaces relevant to the instruction.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 VoxProg在IA排名总得分最高(83.10),在所有三个任务组中,与最高的物理有效性(表1)95.8%、成绩优异的直接网格(48.59%/87.3%)、GenSim2-kPAM(42.72%/77.5%)和GenManip(25.59%/73.2%)一起获得最高的IA排名分数。 虽然Direct Mesh还写了针对特定任务python代码,而不是清晰的场景meshes,但VoxProg将其IA Rank Score改进了34.51分,物理有效性改进了8.5分: 仅代码生成仍然很脆,没有中间代表,无法隔离与指令相关的表面.

blocks.en: Breaking down performance by category reveals how different representations behave under distinct spatial demands. On Functional tasks, VoxProg reaches 86.90 versus 53.57 for Direct Mesh and 34.52 for GenSim2-kPAM (with Physical Validity rising from 75.0% and 78.6% to 92.9% ), as functional use requires isolating mating parts, such as a chute outlet or headphone arch, rather than whole-object bounding boxes or sparse keypoints. On Contextual tasks, the strongest baseline shifts from Direct Mesh (45.98) to GenSim2-kPAM (54.02), while VoxProg retains a clear lead at 77.01 . The largest margin occurs on Geometric tasks: VoxProg reaches an IA Rank Score of 88.10 versus 44.05 for Direct Mesh, although both attain 100.0% Physical Validity. The difference lies in resolving the local contours and clearances that distinguish the intended fit from other physically valid configurations.
blocks.zh: 按类别划分的性能揭示了不同表述在不同的空间需求下的表现方式。 关于功能性任务,VoxProg在直接网格上达到86.90比53.57,在GenSim2-kPAM上达到34.52(物理有效性从75.0%和78.6%升至92.9%),因为功能性使用需要隔离交配部件,如槽口或耳机拱门,而不是全对象边框或稀疏的键点. 关于背景任务,最强基线从Direct Mesh(45.98)转向GenSim2-kPAM(54.02),而VoxProg则保留了77.01的明确领先. 在几何任务中,差值最大:VoxProg的IA排名得分为88.10比44.05,尽管两者都达到100.0%的物理有效性。 不同之处在于解决了局部轮廓和通关问题,将预期的适合性与其他物理上有效的配置区分开来.

blocks.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 3 exposes the gap between locating an object and identifying its functional contact region. In the headphone case (b), all three baselines bring the earcups against the stand or wrap the headphones around its post, missing the inner headband support specified by the instruction. VoxProg matches the inner arch to the curved crown, establishing the intended part-level contact.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图3揭示了发现一个物体和确定其功能接触区域之间的差距。 在耳机情况(b)中,所有三个基线都使耳机对着看台或把耳机包在站台周围,从而缺少指令中规定的内侧头带支持. VoxProg将内拱与弯曲的王冠相匹配,建立预定的部分级接触.

blocks.en: On the sloped stand (a), GenManip leaves the sneaker above the support and GenSim2-kPAM turns it across the ramp. VoxProg aligns the sole with the incline and keeps the toe facing forward. For the VR headset (d), GenManip and GenSim2-kPAM leave the headset above the cradle or in front of the stand, while VoxProg positions it over the stand with the headband behind the front shell. Explicit surface references connect these local contact and orientation requirements to pose computation.
blocks.zh: 在斜坡立面(a)上,GenManip将运动鞋留在支撑上方,GenSim2-kPAM将其翻过斜坡. VoxProg将脚底与内线对齐,并保持脚趾向前. 对于VR耳机(d),GenManip和GenSim2-kPAM在摇篮上方或看台前方留下耳机,而VoxProg则将其置于看台上方前壳后面的头带. 明确的表层参考物将这些局部接触和定向要求连接起来进行计算.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation and external evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 拨款和外部评价

blocks.en: Effect of voxel programming. To separate the effect of staged reference construction from that of local voxel views, we compare Direct Mesh, Mesh Evidence, and VoxProg across all 71 tasks in Table 5 . Direct Mesh writes a single placement program directly over the scene meshes; Mesh Evidence shares VoxProg’s two-stage pipeline and execution feedback but constructs witness regions through direct mesh operations on vertices and faces; VoxProg constructs witnesses on local voxel views while retaining access to the clipped source-mesh surfaces during pose computation.
blocks.zh: Voxel编程的效果. 为了把分阶段的参考构建与本地的Voxel观点区分开来,我们比较了表5中所有71项任务的直接Mesh、Mesh证据和VoxProg。 Direct Mesh直接在场景mesh上写一个单一的放置程序; Mesh Information分享VoxProg的两阶段管道和执行反馈,但通过在顶点和面部直接的网状操作构建见证区域; VoxProg在局部的voxel视图上构建证人,同时在布局计算时保留对剪辑的源-mesh表面的访问.

blocks.en: Within this three-method comparison, moving from single-stage Direct Mesh to the staged Mesh Evidence pipeline raises Physical Validity from 87.3% to 95.8% and more than doubles the IA Rank Score from 26.76 to 56.34 . When a single program must simultaneously locate task-relevant geometry and compute 6-DoF coordinates over raw scene meshes, imprecise region selection directly affects the resulting pose; introducing an explicit evidence stage allows candidate regions to be constructed, checked, and revised before downstream pose synthesis.
blocks.zh: 在这一三套方法的比较中,从单级直接网格转向阶段网格证据管道将物理有效性从87.3%提高到95.8%,将IA排名得分从26.76提高到56.34。 当一个单一的程序必须同时定位与任务相关的几何并计算6-DoF坐标在原始场景间隙上时,不精确的区域选择会直接影响由此产生的姿势;引入一个明确的证据阶段,可以让候选区域在下游进行合成之前被构建,检查和修改.

blocks.zh: 图4: Voxel编程的缩写. 关于VoxProg-Bench的所有71项安置任务的结果。

blocks.zh: 图5:平板投放膨胀。 支持在 Mesh 证据中阻碍屏幕; VoxProg 保持显示清晰.

blocks.en: Replacing direct mesh selection with local voxel views raises the IA Rank Score from 56.34 to 66.90 while maintaining 95.8% Physical Validity. Regular grid indexing and neighborhood operations help resolve the intended receiving side of a structure. In Fig. 5 , Mesh Evidence places the tablet behind the stand’s supports, which obstruct its screen, whereas VoxProg seats it in front with the display unobstructed and facing the user.
blocks.zh: 将直接网格选择与本地的Voxel视图取代,将IA Rank评分从56.34提高到66.90,同时保持95.8%的物理有效性. 常规的网格索引和邻里操作有助于解决一个结构的预期接收方. 以法义. 5, Mesh Information将平板放在看台的支撑后面,这阻碍了看台的屏幕,而VoxProg则将平板放在显示台前,不受阻碍,面对用户.

blocks.en: External placement tasks. We evaluate generalization on 19 tasks adapted from RoboCasa ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) and 13 from Open6DOR v2 ( Ding et al., 2024 ; Qi et al., 2025 ) , formulated as final-state 3D placement problems under matched inputs (Fig. 6 ). On RoboCasa, where appliances and cabinets introduce semi-enclosed boundaries, VoxProg achieves an IA Rank Score of 87.72 against 26.32–45.61 for the baselines, while maintaining 94.7% Physical Validity compared with 26.3%–42.1% for the baselines. On Open6DOR v2, VoxProg leads in IA Rank Score ( 61.54 vs. 57.69 for Direct Mesh) and raises Physical Validity to 92.3% versus 46.2% for Direct Mesh: while broad directional instructions admit many 2D-plausible overhead positions, the baselines often leave objects floating or interpenetrating in 3D.
blocks.zh: 对外安置任务. 我们评价对RoboCasa(Nasiriany等人,2024年)和Open6DOR v2(Ding等人,2024年;Qi等人,2025年)的19项任务的概括,这些任务是在对应投入下作为最终状态3D投放问题(图6)制定的。 在RoboCasa, 电器和柜子采用半封闭边界, VoxProg在基线上实现了87.72比26.32-45.61的IA Rank分数,同时保持94.7%的物理有效性,而基线是26.3~42.1%。 在Open6DOR v2上,VoxProg在IA Rank Score中领先(直接 Mesh的61.54 vs 57.69),并将物理有效性提高到92.3%对46.2%的Direct Mesh:虽然广义方向指令承认许多2D-可置信的俯仰位置,但基线往往让物体在3D中漂浮或互穿.

blocks.en: In the mug task (Fig. 7 a), GenManip leaves the mug beside the dispenser, while GenSim2-kPAM and Direct Mesh leave it interpenetrating the drip tray. VoxProg centers the opening beneath the nozzle and rests the base on the tray, jointly satisfying the alignment and support required to receive coffee. The SD-card task (c) exposes a complementary contact failure: GenManip and Direct Mesh leave the card floating above the USB drive, whereas VoxProg seats it on the top surface.
blocks.zh: 在杯子任务(图7 a)中,GenManip将杯子放在撒布器旁边,而GenSim2-kPAM和Direct Mesh则将杯子放在插管中. VoxProg将喷嘴下面的开口放在托盘上,共同满足获得咖啡所需的对齐和支持. SD卡任务(c)暴露了互补的接触故障:GenManip和Direct Mesh将卡片放在USB驱动器上方,而VoxProg则将其放在顶部表面.

blocks.en: 4.4 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 失败分析

blocks.en: Physical failure profiles. Fig. 8 a decomposes physical rejections on VoxProg-Bench into support and interpenetration failures. GenManip incurs 19 rejections (11 support, 8 intersection), versus 16 for GenSim2-kPAM (13 intersection, 3 support). These patterns are consistent with coarse relation offsets leaving support contact under-specified, and sparse point and axis constraints leaving clearance between extended surfaces under-constrained. Direct Mesh has 9 rejections (6 intersection, 3 support), while both staged variants cut rejections to 3 (3 intersection for Mesh Evidence; 2 intersection, 1 support for VoxProg).
blocks.zh: 物理故障简介. 图8 将VoxProg-Bench上的物理拒绝分解为支持和互渗透失败. GenManip共发生19次拒绝(11次支持,8次交叉),对阵GenSim2-kPAM(13次交叉,3次支持)的16次. 这些模式与粗度关系抵消了使支助接触规格不足以及使扩大的表面之间的清除不受限制的点和轴限制。 Direct Mesh有9个拒绝(6个交叉点,3个支持),而两个阶段变体将拒绝(3个交叉点用于Mesh证据;2个交叉点,1个支持Vox Prog)切成3个.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Failure profiles and contact checks. (a) Physical rejections on VoxProg-Bench. (b) A lid seated from the front floats from the side.
blocks.zh: 图 8:失败简介和联系方式检查。 (a) VoxProg-Bench上的物理拒绝。 (b) 从前面坐的盖子从侧面漂浮。

blocks.en: Visually ambiguous contact. The pot-lid case in Fig. 8 b illustrates why 2D visual inspection alone cannot establish physical validity in 3D object placement. From the primary camera view, the lid appears properly seated: it stands upright with its handle facing outward, its circular contour centered between the side supports, and its lower rim aligned over the receiving rack. A side view of the same final pose reveals, however, that the lid remains suspended above the rack, separated by a clear vertical gap from both the base tray and the inclined backrest. Here, the rack’s opaque front frame provides a strong visual cue to the destination while occluding the recessed region where support contact should occur. Because 2D projection overlap along the viewing ray can conceal 3D separation under self-occlusion, a single-view visual comparison can accept a physically unsupported placement even when the target object and its apparent relation to the reference structure look aligned in image space. Pairing perceptual evaluation with 3D geometric verification addresses this ambiguity by checking local support contact and interpenetration conditions between the placed object and surrounding scene meshes, making the distinction between apparent 2D seating in the rendered view and actual physical support in the 3D scene explicit.
blocks.zh: 视觉模糊的接触。 图8b中的锅盖案说明了为什么仅2D视觉检查无法在3D物体放置中确定物理有效性。 从主摄像头的视角来看,盖子出现适当的坐姿:它直立地站立,其握柄面向向外,其圆形轮廓以侧面支撑为中心,其下方的轮圈与接收架对齐. 然而,从同一最终姿势的侧面看,盖子仍然悬在架子上方,与底盘和倾斜背架之间有明显的垂直间隙。 在此,架子的不透明前框为目的地提供了强烈的视觉提示,同时占据了应当进行支助接触的休眠地区。 由于2D投影沿视线重叠可以隐藏3D在自闭合下分离,所以单视视觉比较即使在目标对象及其与参考结构的明显关系看起来与图像空间一致时,也可以接受物理上不支持的放置. 与3D几何校验对齐的感知评价,通过检查放置对象与周围场景间隙之间的局部支持接触和互穿条件,明确区分了在给定视野中的显式2D座椅与3D场景中的实际物理支持,解决了这一模糊性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented VoxProg, a framework for 3D spatial reasoning that formulates language-guided object placement through voxel programming . Rather than parameterizing tasks over fixed spatial relations or sparse keypoint primitives, VoxProg treats the geometric references required by an instruction as intermediate surface structures constructed by executable code. By coupling regular-grid selection over local voxel views with exact surface normals and patches from the underlying meshes, our two-stage pipeline enables a language model to isolate functional contact regions, verify them through visual and geometric feedback, and solve for physically valid S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) poses. Across the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark and external tasks from RoboCasa and Open6DOR v2, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines in both intent alignment and physical validity. Coupling such programmable surface witnesses with downstream motion generation provides a natural direction for extending fine-grained geometric reasoning from target placement specification to full manipulation execution.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了VoxProg,一个3D空间推理框架,通过Voxel编程来制定语言引导对象布置. VoxProg不将固定空间关系或稀疏的键点原始物上的任务参数化,而是将指令所要求的几何参考物作为中间表面结构,由可执行代码构建. 我们的两阶段管道将本地阴道视图的正网选择与基础网格的精确表面常态和补丁结合,使一个语言模型能够隔离功能接触区,通过视觉和几何反馈进行验证,并解决物理上有效的S E (3) SE (3) 。 通过RoboCasa和Open6DOR v2的71任务VoxProg-Bench基准和外部任务,VoxProg在意图对齐和物理有效性方面始终超越基于关系、关键点和网点的基线。 将这种可编程的表面见证与下游运动生成相连接,为将精细的几何推理从目标放置规格延伸至完全操纵执行提供了自然方向.
